snippet.title: Coupling - An Abstract Puzzle Indie Game
snippet.description:
Coupling is an abstract style puzzle game where red objects rotate and blue objects move following the player, and you need to utilize their properties to pass the levels.
The Steam wishlist is now open, check it out if you're interested:  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694470/Coupling/
